description.narrative: The Fund will increase access to equity and operational value added for tech startups in Indonesia, particularly for female founded companies. In the context of a region where women-led enterprises received less than 9% of equity, ACV has demonstrated itself as a market leader in investing in female founded companies. ACV previously committed to investing in 35% female founded companies in its predecessor fund; and initial analysis shows they are on track to achieve this objective. In Fund V, ACV is expected to expand on this commitment and continue to establish itself as a more influential local player that demonstrates that investing in female founders also delivers financial returns. Beyond the project, the Fund will continue to increase innovation in key sectors in Indonesia through the support of market-disrupting digital business models. Indonesia is the most established venture market in ASEAN and holds the majority of Unicorn tech businesses in the region. Yet given the size of Indonesias economy, there remains room for further digital integration.

The proposed investment is (i) an equity investment up to US$20.35M in ACV Capital V L.P (ACV Fund V or the Fund) and (ii) a separate co-investment envelope up to US$20M to invest alongside ACV managed funds. ACV Fund V is a US$200M (target) Indonesia focused venture capital (VC) fund. The Fund will be managed by ACV Capital V G.P (ACV or the Manager). ACV Fund V shall make initial investments in Seed to Series A stage and make follow-on investments through Series B. The Fund will focus on climate tech, fintech, SME tech, eCommerce, edtech, and healthtech sectors.
